_meta._prompt_safety: The free-text description fields below contain references to the 2022-09-11 collapse for human auditors. They are metadata only and MUST NOT be surfaced into any model prompt — phase1.masks.loader.load_masks loads only geometry. If you change that, audit the descriptions first.
_meta.cross_referenced_against: Torres-Cruz & O'Donovan 2023, Scientific Reports, Figure 2 panel (h) 2021-02-09 (Google Earth Pro). DOI 10.1038/s41598-023-31633-5. The paper's panel shows a single connected TSF with breaches A and B labelled on the SE wall; the SimSat 2021-12 tile (10 months later) shows the same kidney shape with the pond pressed against that same SE/S wall. Polygon vertices traced from visible boundaries in the SimSat RGB and validated against the paper panel's outline.
_meta.drawn_at_pixel_resolution: 509x506 (pixel_lon=0.0001019 deg, pixel_lat=0.0000891 deg, ≈9.85 m/px lon, 9.90 m/px lat)
_meta.fidelity: v1.1 — traced from observable feature boundaries with paper cross-reference, then refined to (a) constrict the impoundment's east edge so it no longer overlaps the town and (b) include the SE residential extension in the protected zone. Edge accuracy approximately ±20 m (2 pixels). Sufficient for trend analysis. Refine via QGIS digitisation against higher-resolution imagery for absolute-number reporting.

properties.description: Main Jagersfontein TSF — single connected kidney-shape impoundment as of late 2021. Includes pond, tailings beach, and retained slurry. The 2022-09-11 collapse occurred along this footprint's SE wall (breaches A and B in Torres-Cruz Fig 2h).

Southern perimeter dam wall — the failure side per Torres-Cruz Fig 2h (Breaches A and B labels on this segment). ~60 m wide strip along the impoundment's S boundary. Inner edge follows impoundment polygon; outer edge offset ~60 m south.

Run-out wedge immediately south of the retaining wall. Where breach material flowed in 2022. Bounded north by the wall, south by the image edge. The 2022-09 mudflow extended further south than the 5 km tile captures — the downstream zone in this mask is the proximal portion only.

Jagersfontein town centre and SE residential extension (Kopanong Local Municipality). Polygon carved on the southwest side to avoid overlapping the impoundment. The 2022-09-11 mudflow reached this zone via the receiving watercourse — protected-party polygon for Claim 5.
